inputs.text: chat sticker. The character: SUBJECT. What it does: EXPRESSION - clearly readable, like a classic emoji sticker. Near-photorealistic digital painting that looks like a real photo of this exact animal or person: true-to-life anatomy, proportions and face shape, natural eye size, realistic fur and hair texture, exactly the described colors in muted natural tones, no warm brown or orange tint, exactly the described coat pattern and markings, no stripes unless described. Anatomically correct real paws covered in fur with small toes and toe pads mostly hidden by fur (no cartoon mitten paws, no big pink pads), or natural human hands with five fingers. Natural lighting. Only the pose and the doodles are playful. Whole character centered, isolated on a plain flat pale blue background. No text, no letters, no words, no speech bubbles.
